bhakoot.interpretation: Excellent financial and family prospects - prosperity and growth expected.
bhakoot.name: Bhakoot (Financial & Family Prosperity)
bhakoot.significance: Bhakoot indicates financial prosperity, family growth, and overall fortune of the couple. It is one of the most important factors for material success in marriage.
tips: Plan finances together and maintain transparency
If Bhakoot Dosha exists, perform recommended remedies
Focus on creating joint financial goals

gana.interpretation: Contrasting natures - significant effort needed for peaceful coexistence.
gana.name: Gana (Temperament & Nature)
gana.significance: Gana indicates the basic temperament and nature - Dev (divine), Manushya (human), or Rakshasa (demon). It shows how partners will behave in daily life and conflicts.
tips: Understand your partner's natural temperament
Don't try to change each other's basic nature
Use differences as complementary strengths

grahaMaitri.interpretation: Moderate mental compatibility - can understand each other with effort.
grahaMaitri.name: Graha Maitri (Mental & Intellectual Harmony)
grahaMaitri.significance: Graha Maitri indicates mental and intellectual compatibility based on the friendship between the lords of Moon signs. It affects communication, understanding, and thinking patterns.
tips: Practice active listening and clear communication
Appreciate different perspectives as opportunities to learn
Find common intellectual interests to bond over

nadi.interpretation: Nadi Dosha present - same energy channel may cause health issues.
nadi.name: Nadi (Health & Genetic Compatibility)
nadi.significance: Nadi indicates health compatibility and genetic factors. Same Nadi creates Nadi Dosha which may affect health of offspring and overall family health.
tips: If Nadi Dosha exists, perform Nadi Dosha Nivarana Puja
Consult an Ayurvedic doctor for health guidance
Maintain healthy lifestyle for family well-being

tara.interpretation: Good everyday compatibility with minor adjustments needed.
tara.name: Tara (Birth Star Harmony)
tara.significance: Tara indicates the day-to-day compatibility and the general luck the couple will experience together. It affects health, well-being, and daily harmony.
tips: Pay attention to auspicious times for important activities
Perform Nakshatra Shanti if Tara is unfavorable
Practice patience during challenging daily moments

varna.interpretation: Excellent spiritual harmony - both partners will respect each other's values and ego.
varna.name: Varna (Spiritual Compatibility)
varna.significance: Varna represents the spiritual and ego compatibility between partners. It indicates whether two individuals can respect each other's spiritual nature and work harmoniously together.
tips: Focus on shared spiritual values and mutual respect
Practice meditation or spiritual activities together
Accept and appreciate differences in approach to life

vasya.interpretation: Strong mutual attraction with clear dynamics - one partner naturally complements the other.
vasya.name: Vasya (Mutual Attraction & Influence)
vasya.significance: Vasya indicates the power of mutual attraction and the ability to influence each other. It shows which partner may naturally take leadership and how they will interact in decision-making.
tips: Understand your natural dynamic and use it positively
Practice compromise and joint decision-making
Appreciate each partner's unique strengths

yoni.interpretation: Moderate physical compatibility - may need effort to sync.
yoni.name: Yoni (Physical & Sexual Compatibility)
yoni.significance: Yoni represents physical and sexual compatibility based on animal instincts associated with birth stars. It indicates the nature of physical relationship and intimacy.
tips: Communicate openly about physical needs and preferences
Be patient and understanding with each other
Focus on emotional intimacy to complement physical connection

guidance: Strongly recommend consulting an experienced astrologer
Consider compatibility from other charts (Navamsa, Dashamsa)
If proceeding, extensive remedies and counseling are essential
interpretation.marriageProspects: Marriage not recommended without extensive remedies and careful consideration.
interpretation.summary: A challenging match with significant compatibility concerns.

data.recommendation: Low compatibility - Not recommended for marriage
remedies: Nadi Dosha: Perform Nadi Dosha Nivarana Puja
